title: Genesis 2:21 — the first Adam and the Last Adam compared
summary: Genesis 2:21 (God causes a deep sleep to fall on the man and takes one of his sides), followed by a two-column comparison of the 1st Adam and the Last Adam: both are sons of God with a miraculous birth, a side opened, put to sleep, and waking up with a bride, though in a different order for the two.

text.text: 21 So the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; then He took one of his sides and closed up the flesh at that place.
Son of God | Son of God
Wakes up with bride | Wakes up with bride

uncertain: The slide gives no Hebrew verse text, only the Hebrew reference; “Last Adam” is not explained as Jesus on the slide itself.
